title: Gateway pipeline: a non-numeric maxConnections fails the update at start, not at create

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard gateway, one run

symptom: maxConnections "abc": the create succeeded. The update FAILED at start with _LEGACY_ERROR_TEMP_84_FAILED_TO_PARSE_PIPELINE_CONF and CLUSTER_SETUP_FAILURE.EXECUTION_SERVICE_INITIALIZATION_FAILED on each cluster after four retries. No tables were created.
cause: Not established. The value is parsed when the gateway's cluster starts, so the parse error surfaces as a cluster setup failure.
effect: The update never starts, and the error names no setting.
